jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Fruit production guide (Kenya)

varieties.name: Sunrise Solo
varieties.supplier_notes: Export standard: small 500-800 g fruit, sweet red flesh.

varieties.name: Mountain
varieties.supplier_notes: Local workhorse: bigger fruit, open-market favourite.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow 2-3 fresh seeds per hole at 2.5m × 2.5m (~640 plants per acre), 1 cm deep.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu 2-3 mbichi kwa shimo kwa 2.5m × 2.5m (~mimea 640 kwa eka), kina cha 1 cm.

timeline_template.description_en: Thin to the strongest seedling per hole.
timeline_template.description_sw: Acha mche mmoja imara kwa shimo.

timeline_template.description_en: At first flowering, remove MALE plants (long stalks, many small flowers, no fruit). Keep females and hermaphrodites.
timeline_template.description_sw: Wakati wa maua ya kwanza, ondoa mimea ya KIUME (mashina marefu, maua mengi madogo, bila matunda). Acha za kike na mbingu.
timeline_template.tip_en: Left unchecked, males become half your stand and produce nothing.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Bila kudhibitiwa, waume wanakuwa nusu ya shamba bila mazao.

timeline_template.description_en: Top-dress manure + NPK per plant every 2 months — pawpaw is a heavy continuous feeder.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka samadi + NPK kwa kila mmea kila miezi 2 — papai linalisha sana mfululizo.

timeline_template.description_en: First fruit colours at the tip — pick at first colour break; pawpaw ripens off the plant.
timeline_template.description_sw: Tunda la kwanza linabadilika rangi kwenye ncha — vuna rangi inapoanza; papai huiva nje ya mmea.
timeline_template.tip_en: Keep a nursery strip going — pawpaw declines after 4-5 years; the replanting rhythm never stops.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Dumisha kitalu — papai hudhoofika baada ya miaka 4-5; mduara wa kupanda upya hausimami.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Pick at first colour break; export-grade Solo by size and blemish.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Ripens off the plant; cool shade extends shelf life a few days.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Huiva nje ya mmea; kivuli baridi huongeza siku za kuuzika.

diseases.symptoms_en: Mottled distorted leaves, oily ring spots on fruit, dark streaks on stems, plants stop producing.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani yaliyopinda yenye madoa, pete za mafuta kwenye matunda, michirizi meusi mashina.
diseases.treatment_en: None — rogue and destroy immediately; aphid control only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze mara moja; dhibiti vidukari tu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Tolerant varieties (Calina), early aphid control, clean seedlings.
diseases.prevention_sw: Aina sugu (Calina), dhibiti vidukari mapema, miche safi.
diseases.scanner_notes: Ring spots on FRUIT are the signature — photograph fruit and leaves together.

diseases.symptoms_en: White dusting on leaves in warm-dry spells.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class products at first dusting. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.symptoms_en: Sunken dark spots on ripening fruit, pink ooze in humidity.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meusi yaliyozama kwenye matunda yanayoiva, ute wa pinki.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered anthracnose-active sprays; clean handling. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa za anthracnose; shika safi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.symptoms_en: Seedlings collapse at soil line; established plants wilt and die in wet soil.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Miche huanguka; mimea mikubwa hunyauka na kufa kwenye udongo wenye maji.
diseases.treatment_en: None once advanced — drainage is the cure. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba ikiwa imeendelea — mifereji ndio dawa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Raised beds, strict drainage, no collar watering.
diseases.prevention_sw: Vitanda vilivyoinuliwa, mifereji kali, usimwagilie shina.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the plant base; ask about water pooling.

diseases.symptoms_en: Pin-prick stings on ripening fruit, larvae inside, fruit rots.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kuchomwa kwenye matunda yanayoiva, viluwiluwi ndani.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered bait sprays; remove fallen fruit. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za chambo zilizoidhinishwa; ondoa yaliyoanguka. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Year-round bearing with little seasonality — a fruiting plant is a continuous trickle of income. Solo for the exporter, Mountain for the local market.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Kuzaa mwaka mzima bila msimu — mmea unaozaa ni kipato cha kudumu. Solo kwa nje, Mountain kwa soko la ndani.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 20–50 KES per kg local (November 2026); export-grade Solo several multiples. Establishment 20,000–35,000 KES per acre; first revenue month 8-12.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 20–50 kwa kilo ndani (Novemba 2026); Solo ya nje mara kadhaa zaidi. Uanzishaji 20,000–35,000 KES; kipato cha kwanza mwezi 8-12.
